added.summary: Takes charge, 0 to 1 (a super or a focus meter): a bar fills along its foot, and the button lights and breathes when it is full. Negative, the default, shows none.

Pack slots for a hero action (Hero.frame with .premium, .secondary, .danger and .ready; Hero.label; Hero.charge and .fill), a hold's progress (Hold.fill with .danger and .primary) and more of an ability's parts (Ability.icon and .disabled, Ability.tint, Ability.slash, Ability.pip and .on, Ability.chip.cost, .short and .count).

fixed.summary: Draws every part from the theme's Ability slots, as ShooterAbilities does: the theme's slot art, size, ring and sweep. An ultimate shows its charge in figures on its own chip and Ready when full. A disabled or locked slot greys only its art, so its seconds stay readable. Ranks are pips.
Draws the theme's Ability slots (its art, size and sweep) and nudges when it comes ready.
A round theme's ready ultimate glows round instead of in a square, the charge in figures sits on its own chip so it reads over a light scene, and a disabled slot's seconds keep their ink.
